project_type: Vite + React 18 + TypeScript SPA (web) + Expo/React Native app (mobile) sharing a single Supabase backend
build_system: Web: Vite (vite.config.ts) with @vitejs/plugin-react. Mobile: Expo SDK 57 / expo-router. Path alias @/* resolves to src/* in both apps.
test_framework: No test framework present — verification is TypeScript type-check only
test_command: cd /Users/aryansinghthakur/Downloads/Veducore && npm run typecheck   (runs: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json)
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm run typecheck` from /Users/aryansinghthakur/Downloads/Veducore and confirm exit code 0 with zero output. 2. Optionally run `npm run build` to confirm Vite also produces no errors.
environment_constraints: VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY are already set in .env. Do not expose secrets in code. Mobile app needs `npm install @supabase/supabase-js@2.57.4` run inside /Users/aryansinghthakur/Downloads/Veducore/app/ before the supabase.ts client file is used.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow the existing code style: named exports, async/await, supabase client from @/lib/supabase, type imports from @/types.
key_patterns: 1. All Supabase calls follow the pattern: `const { data, error } = await supabase.from('table').select/insert/update/delete...; if (error) throw error; return data as Type`. 2. api.ts is a thin re-export layer over realApi.ts — pages import from @/services/api, never directly from realApi. 3. RLS helper functions get_current_school_id(), is_admin(), is_teacher(), is_parent() are defined in migration 001 and reused in all policy definitions. 4. Every new table needs: uuid PK, school_id FK, created_at/updated_at timestamptz, RLS enabled, set_updated_at trigger.
directory_structure: / — workspace root (web app). src/services/ — api layer. src/auth/ — auth contexts. src/lib/ — mockData, mockDb, supabase client, utils. src/types/index.ts — all shared TypeScript interfaces. src/pages/ — page components by role (admin/, teacher/, parent/, shared/). supabase/migrations/ — SQL migration files 001–004 already applied. app/ — Expo React Native mobile app. app/src/lib/ — mobile helpers including mockData.ts and mockDb.ts. app/package.json — mobile dependencies (no @supabase/supabase-js yet).
